OpenHAB | Vendor and technology agnostic open source automation software

summary.one_liner: openHAB Core is the core OSGi bundle framework of the openHAB home automation runtime, built with Maven and intended to be picked up by the main openHAB distribution.
summary.what_it_does: The repository contains the core bundles of the openHAB runtime, packaged as OSGi bundles. The README describes it as a framework to build solutions on top rather than a standalone product. The build is Maven-based and requires Java SE Development Kit 21 and Maven 3. Running the documented build command compiles and packages all sources, with options to skip tests or checks for a faster build. The README covers only building; it does not describe end-user features or how to run a home automation setup.
use_cases: build openhab core bundles from source
produce osgi bundle artifacts for home automation
how_to_run: Install Java SE Development Kit 21 and Maven 3, and make sure mvn is on your PATH
git clone the openhab-core repository from GitHub
For a faster build: mvn clean install -T1C -DskipChecks -DskipTests -Dspotless.check.skip=true
notable: Vendor and technology agnostic smart home runtime foundation
Packaged as OSGi bundles for use in openHAB products
Build options to skip tests, checks, or spotless formatting for faster builds
caveats: Not a end-user product on its own; it is a framework picked up by the main openHAB distribution
Requires Java 21 and Maven 3 to build
Some tests may fail intermittently on local builds, per the README
